texts.d6eed5329905: To identify when a patient with Oro and Oropharyngeal malignancy dies and the cause of the death inorder to update the prospective Head and Neck Oncology database at the Regional Maxilliofacial Unit.  The database is comprehensive and address demographic details, investigation, treatment modalities, pathology, adjuvant treatments and outcomes.
